records.title: Computer-Aided Diagnostic System for Pulmonary Nodule Segmentation and Malignancy Classification in Low-Dose CT Scans Using Attention CNNs
records.description: A 3D convolutional neural network architecture with volumetric spatial attention mechanisms for early detection of lung cancer lesions in chest CT scans.

records.title: Automated Histopathology Slide Analysis Apparatus Utilizing Multi-Scale Deep Feature Representation for Breast Cancer Grading
records.description: Apparatus and computerized methodology for gigapixel whole-slide imaging analysis, tumor bed segmentation, and Nottingham histological score calculation.
records.organization: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

records.title: Autonomous In-Orbit Docking Mechanism and Proximity Operations Guidance System for Satellite Servicing and Space Debris Remediation
records.description: Computer vision and electromagnetic latching interface enabling non-cooperative target capture, active debris removal, and in-space assembly.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Dipak Kumar Giri, Shubhankar Roy

records.title: Non-Invasive EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interface System with Real-Time Neural Decoding for Neuroprosthetic Limb Control
records.description: An adaptive spatial filter and Riemannian geometry manifold decoding framework for continuous motor imagery translation into multi-axis robotic prosthesis commands.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Tapan K. Gandhi, Anubha Gupta

records.title: Implantable High-Density Neural Microelectrode Array with Wireless Neuromodulation and Bidirectional Neural Signal Acquisition
records.description: Biocompatible flexible polyimide microelectrode array with on-chip low-noise analog front-end for neural spike recording and closed-loop stimulation.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Maryam Shojaei Baghini, Rahul Kulkarni
